playbookOutputs: CIPC CoR 39 Certificate showing the outgoing director status as Resigned
Updated CIPC CoR 14.3 / Enterprise Disclosure Certificate
Signed Resignation Letter and Board Acceptance Resolution
playbookCommonFailures: Company only has 1 director and no new director is being appointed simultaneously (a Private Company must have at least 1 active director at all times)
Resigning director email or cellphone number on CIPC records is outdated so the CIPC CoR 39 OTP cannot be received without a contact details amendment first
Certified IDs of the resigning or remaining directors are older than 3 months
Client confuses director resignation with shareholder exit — CoR 39 does not transfer shares or update the Beneficial Ownership register

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3 / Disclosure Certificate)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 or Disclosure Certificate showing enterprise registration number and current active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Resigning Director Full Name, ID Number, Email Address, Cellphone Number & Effective Resignation Date
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the resigning director full name, ID number, direct email, cellphone number (for CIPC OTP verification), and effective date of resignation.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy of the Resigning Director (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Certified ID copy (< 3 months) of the resigning director.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Remaining Active Directors (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified ID copies (< 3 months) for every remaining active director who will stay on the board.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Remaining Active Directors — Full Names, Email Addresses & Cellphone Numbers (for CIPC OTPs)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the email address and cellphone number for each remaining active director.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Resignation Letter from the Outgoing Director
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed letter of resignation (we can also draft this for signature if not yet prepared).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed formal resignation letter from the outgoing director addressed to the Board of Directors stating the company name, effective date of resignation, and signature.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Board Resolution Accepting the Director Resignation
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the board resolution signed by the directors accepting the voluntary resignation (we draft this for signature if needed).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Board resolution of the company noting and accepting the resignation of the outgoing director with effective date and signatures of the board.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect resigning & remaining director IDs, contact details, and effective date
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR 14.3, certified IDs (< 3 months), OTP contact details, and effective resignation date received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm that at least 1 active director will remain on the board after the resignation (if the resigning director is the sole director, a replacement director must be appointed simultaneously). Clarify whether the resigning director is also selling/transferring shares.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify KYC certifications, board minimum count, and CIPC company status
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All ID certifications verified < 90 days; company is "In Business" and has >= 1 remaining director
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify the company status on CIPC and check that all uploaded IDs meet the 90-day Commissioner of Oaths certification rule.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft Director Resignation Letter, Board Acceptance Resolution & CoR 39 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Resignation letter, board acceptance resolution, and CoR 39 handoff sheet drafted for review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: If the client has not already uploaded a signed resignation letter and board resolution, draft both documents ready for signature.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Obtain signed Resignation Letter and signed Board Acceptance Resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed resignation letter and signed board resolution uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Send the drafted resignation letter and board resolution to the client for signature and PDF upload.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Stage CoR 39 voluntary resignation on CIPC e-Services and coordinate OTPs
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR 39 resignation filed on CIPC e-Services, dual-channel OTPs verified, and supporting documents uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: File CoR 39 on CIPC e-Services changing the director status to Resigned with the effective date. Coordinate the SMS + Email OTPs with the directors and upload the certified IDs, signed resignation letter, and board resolution.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to issue the CoR 39 certificate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CIPC CoR 39 confirmation received showing the director as Resigned
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Monitor CIPC tracking status until the CoR 39 certificate is issued.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR 39 confirmation and updated CoR 14.3 disclosure certificate
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR 39 certificate and updated CoR 14.3 posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the CoR 39 and updated disclosure certificate. Remind the client to update bank signatories and, if shareholding also changed, to update the Share Register and Beneficial Ownership filing.
